text:
Bundles & Special Offers on Google Devices - Google Store

# Bundles & Special Offers on Google Devices - Google Store

## Terms & Conditions

Get a 50% line discount for 12 months via monthly bill credits, applicable per line for each person that brings a phone and joins the Unlimited Essentials or Unlimited Standard plan (new users only) at fi.google.com, store.google.com and Google retail stores, ending 11/30/26 at 9:59am PT, or while supplies last. On Unlimited Essentials, pay $17.50/mo for 1 line, $30/mo for 2 lines, $40/mo for 3 lines, $45/mo for 4 lines, $56.50/mo for 5 lines, or $67.50/mo for 6 lines for 12 months. On Unlimited Standard, pay $25/mo for 1 line, $40/mo for 2 lines, $45/mo for 3 lines, $50/mo for 4 lines, $62.50/mo for 5 lines, or $75/mo for 6 lines for 12 months. Bill credits are applied to plan charges (e.g., data, calls, texts) and taxes and fees on the newly activated line, and exclude financing costs, device protection and international charges. While this offer cannot be combined with other device promotions, it will remain valid when purchasing a new device (without any promotion) or switching to a new device before 12 months. Changing, or suspending the account before 12 months will void promotion and credits will stop. Promotions are non-transferable, not valid for cash or cash equivalent. US residents with US shipping addresses only. Must be 18 years or older, with Google Pay and Google Fi Wireless accounts. Limit 1 per customer or group plan member. Taxes payable at checkout. Void where prohibited.

...

Pixel discount: Get a discount of $500 at checkout and $599 back over 24 monthly bill credits for purchase of a Pixel 11 Pro, at fi.google.com, store.google.com and Google retail stores. Must select 'Google Fi' in the 'Choose a carrier' step of the purchase process. Taxes payable at checkout. Phone activation required by 30 days of shipment confirmation. Changing devices before 120 days invalidates instant discount, resulting in $500 charge, and cancellation, pause, or change of Fi plan before 24 months will terminate promotion and bill credits will stop.

...

Actual value is $119.94 based on monthly auto-renewal rate. The Google AI Pro plan offer is available to users with the purchase and activation of a Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL or Pixel 11 Pro Fold. Must be a U.S. resident, 18 years or older. Offer is not available to: Google One users subscribed to an add-on, Google One users subscribed to a higher tier plan than the one being offered, Google One users on a family plan who are not the plan manager, and Google One users who have a subscription through a third party or affiliate. Redeem the offer by October 31, 2027 at 11:59pm PT. Valid form of payment required at sign-up, but you will not be charged until the trial period expires. Unless canceled earlier, Google AI Pro will charge [$19.99] after the trial ends, or then-current subscription fee (minus applied offers plus applicable taxes) billed on a recurring monthly basis. Cancel anytime. No refunds for partial billing periods, except as required by applicable law. Return of purchased device may result in cancellation of subscription. See g.co/pixel/google-ai-pro-pixel11pro-6-month-offer for more details.
